form.official-title: To amend the Department of Housing and Urban Development Act to require the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to testify on an annual basis before the Congress.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the HUD Accountability Act of 2024.
Section 7 of the Department of Housing and Urban Development Act (42 U.S.C. 3535) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:

subsection.text: During the 5-year period beginning on the date of the enactment of this subsection, the Secretary shall appear before the Committee on Financial Services of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs of the Senate at an annual hearing and present testimony regarding the operations of the Department during the preceding year, including regarding the following topics:

paragraph.text: The progress made by the Federal Government in ending the affordable housing and homelessness crises.
The current programs and operations of the Department.
The physical condition of all public housing and other housing assisted by the Department.
The financial health of the mortgage insurance funds of the FHA.
Oversight by the Department of grantees and sub-grantees for purposes of preventing waste, fraud, and abuse.

The effects of the changes made in 2017 to the Federal income tax deduction for State and local taxes (known as the SALT deduction) on the cost of homeownership in the United States, except that this paragraph shall not apply at any time that such tax deduction is in effect in the same form and manner as immediately before such 2017 changes.
Other ongoing activities of the Department, as appropriate.
